schema.description: A1 — Trust summary. Mirrors the trust-core fields the indexer surfaces under `/v4/verifiable-trust/resolve` for this DID, plus the graph-level `lastObservedAtTime`.

evaluatedAtTime.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC. MUST include the date, the time (with seconds), and the trailing `Z` UTC designator. Fractional seconds are OPTIONAL. Local times, non-UTC offsets, date-only values, and timezone-less times are NOT permitted.
evaluatedAtTime.title: traverse_response_Iso8601DateTime

oneOf.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC. MUST include the date, the time (with seconds), and the trailing `Z` UTC designator. Fractional seconds are OPTIONAL. Local times, non-UTC offsets, date-only values, and timezone-less times are NOT permitted.
oneOf.title: traverse_response_Iso8601DateTime

expiresAtTime.description: Earliest trust-flipping boundary per [IDX-VT-EVAL-2]; `null` when no boundary exists (never trust-expires until an upstream re-evaluation).

pattern.description: Architecture pattern per VS-REQ-3 / VS-REQ-4 (A: self-issued; B: delegated); null when the DID presents no ServiceCredential (untrusted DID).
pattern.title: traverse_response_Pattern

corporationId.description: Stable `uint64` id of the DID's owner Corporation per the VPR DID ownership invariant. Never null.

lastObservedAtTime.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC. MUST include the date, the time (with seconds), and the trailing `Z` UTC designator. Fractional seconds are OPTIONAL. Local times, non-UTC offsets, date-only values, and timezone-less times are NOT permitted.
lastObservedAtTime.title: traverse_response_Iso8601DateTime

schema.title: traverse_response_A1Output
